A cell with a record is shown as an explained gap, never as 'not tagged' without a reason. Metrics follow scripts/hyperscalers/tags.mjs. Amounts in US$ millions. reviewedBy stays null until a person signs off. result last_tagged = the company stopped tagging the concept (the latest fact is shown with its date; no later figure exists). derived = a trailing-twelve-month figure built from tagged facts plus periods whose cash-flow statement carries no such line (listed in zeroPeriods and read as zero: a complete statement omits a line only when it is nil), with every input's accession; rendered as 'derived' with the method in the ⓘ card and counted as a value present (FNAM calculation), never as quote-matched.
